page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 64 physical cores and 64 virtual CPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The configuration features a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, ensuring that each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core without hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Because the instance lacks integrated GPUs and local storage, it is not designed for hardware-accelerated machine learning or high-IOPS local database caching. However, the dedicated core allocation and 3.1 GHz clock speed provide predictable compute performance. This resource profile is suitable for multi-threaded general-purpose workloads, application servers, containerized microservices, and distributed enterprise applications that rely on network-attached storage.
